excerpts: Pack is an AI Change Management Platform that shows companies which skills their people have today, which skills are missing, and what capabilities are needed to achieve their strategic goals. We enable organisations to develop the talent they already have, reduce hiring and training costs, and ensure that every role builds the capabilities required by the business. When employees develop the skills that directly support the company's priorities, they become more engaged, and the organisation becomes more productive and resilient. How Pack works? Three integrated steps: Skill mapping: we translate the company's strategy into a clear skill framework and define the capabilities required for each role. Skill assessment: we measure each person's current skill level and potential, making strengths and gaps visible and actionable. Targeted development: we create personalised, AI-powered learning paths that build the exact capabilities needed, with clear goals and progress tracking. Pack unites a rigorous methodology with an AI-native platform to manage the entire talent development lifecycle, from defining strategic skills to developing them at scale.

citations.title: Pack bags €5.8M to accelerate its international expansion - Tech.eu
excerpts: Italy-based [Pack](https://www.thepack.tech/it) , the AI-native HR tech startup, has closed a Series A funding round totalling €5.8 million. Following an initial €3.5 million tranche in September 2025 led by [Rialto VC](https://rialto.vc/) , the second tranche marks the entry of US-based Acadian Ventures, a fund specialising in the future of work technology. The round also includes leading HR and SaaS figures such as David Clarke, Thomas Otter, Jason Corsello, Steven Hunt, Luca Saracino, Doris Tomanek and Jeroen Van Hautte. Pack was advised on the transaction by Bonelli Erede, with partner Giulia Bianchi Frangipane and senior associate Enrico Goitre supporting the legal structuring of the deal. Founded in 2022 by [Pietro Maria Picogna](https://www.linkedin.com/in/pietromariapicogna/) and [Giacomo Gentili](https://www.linkedin.com/in/giacomo-gentili/) , Pack is a people-development platform that helps companies map skills, assess potential and support personalised development paths, including coaching, mentoring and targeted training, through a continuous AI-powered monitoring system. Its goal is to help organisations grow through skills, making teams more agile, informed and prepared for future challenges. > Companies don't just need HR software; they need an intelligent partner capable of interpreting people data and turning it into strategic decisions. Our mission is to make organisations more aware, agile and future-ready, > > explains Giacomo Gentili, CPO and co-founder of Pack. With this round, Pack strengthens its position among Europe's HR tech startups, supported by its international outlook, proprietary technology and AI-native culture. The company has grown to a 30-person team across two countries and plans to reach 50 employees within the next six months, with new hires focused on product, AI and customer success. The new capital will support this hiring plan, enable expansion into France, Germany and the United Kingdom, and accelerate Pack's AI roadmap, with the aim of establishing the company as a European leader in Human Capital Intelligence.

basis.reasoning: The fully reviewed small team roster lists CEO Pietro Maria Picogna and CPO Giacomo Gentili as cofounders, with no other C-level or VP-level people: https://thepack.tech/about-us. Their founding roles are consistent with the funding announcement: https://tech.eu/2025/12/02/pack-bags-eur58m-to-accelerate-its-international-expansion. No qualifying appointment or departure was found. Confidence is limited because the team roster is undated.
